messages:
liam: Quick note - onboarding sample-app (streaming + pagination + client throttle) is getting stuck on some users. They see repeated 429s and the client never recovers. Root looks like prefetch + streaming interplay. Anyone dug in?
sophia: Which SDK/version? Python/JS parity?
liam: Repro on JS 0.9.3 and py-sdk 0.4.1. Behavior slightly different: JS keeps prefetching and inflight counter drifts up; Py stops prefetching but leaves held pages pending indefinitely.
kevin: Sounds like a state-machine mismatch between SDKs. We added a PRE-FETCH queued state recently. If 429 arrives mid-stream, JS retries and requeues, Py flips to HELD but never decrements inflight on cancel.
anya: Can you paste logs? Small snippet of the JS client state transitions would help.
liam: pasted minimal traces: STREAM_START -> PREFETCH_ISSUED -> PREFETCH_QUEUED -> 429_RECEIVED -> PREFETCH_RETRY_ENQUEUED -> INFLIGHT=+1 (expected -1).
devex-bot: opsbot: Canary deploy of prefetch heuristics rolled 2026-03-18 09:40 UTC.
sophia: Workaround for onboarding: set prefetch=0 for streaming, or reduce throttle window to 1. But we should fix SDK parity so both stop issuing new prefetches when a backoff state is active.
kevin: Proposed fix: treat 429 as TRANSIENT_BACKOFF and move queued prefetched items to a temporary hold list; do not decrement inflight until hold is resolved via backoff success or explicit cancel. Also ensure cancel path decrements inflight. I'll open PR with tests.
anya: Also let's not expose a new config to users in onboarding; default change is better: prefetch=0 in streaming, and in docs call out "prefetch reserved for non-streaming pagination".
liam: I've filed DX-8087 with repro instructions, logs and suggested e2e that simulates intermittent 429 from the runner. Link (internal): https://internal.redwood/dx/8087
sophia: For release notes we'll say: "Onboarding sample app: improved prefetch/backpressure handling to avoid stuck inflight state on 429". Keep it simple.
kevin: Added unit+integration tests, will add a small e2e that toggles prefetch defaults depending on streaming flag.
liam: Thanks. If anyone on call wants to pair on e2e harness tomorrow ping me. :wave:
